README

backoff

A small Go package for retrying operations with jittered exponential backoff. It has no dependencies outside the standard library, and every delay it computes is deterministic for a given seed, which makes tests easy to write.

The package grew out of a set of copy-pasted retry loops in our services, each slightly different, and each wrong in its own way. We wanted one implementation that respects context cancellation, never sleeps longer than the configured cap, and is boring to read.

Install

go get github.com/lanternlabs/backoff@latest

Usage

err := backoff.Retry(ctx, backoff.Default, func() error {
	return callService()
})

See the package documentation for the full API, and CONTRIBUTING.md if you would like to send a patch.
